title: REKI: Registering Knowledge in VLAs
abstract: arXiv:2610.22178v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We introduce REKI, a 2.4B vision-language-action model (VLA) pretrained exclusively on public data that sets a new Pareto frontier between performance and model size: on LIBERO-Plus, RoboTwin Clean2Rand and RoboCasa365, it is outperformed only by models about twice its size. REKI consists of a vision-language model (VLM) followed by a flow-matching action expert, and is pretrained on a curated mixture of public robot, egocentric human and vision-language data. Additionally, we endow it with a memory that gives the policy access to its recent past at negligible cost: a few register tokens in the action expert summarise the output of the VLM at each frame and persist in the expert's cache. This memory improves success in simulation and on real robots, and makes oscillations between poses about four times rarer. translated_title: REKI：在视觉-语言-动作模型中注册知识
translated_abstract: 我们推出了REKI，一个完全基于公开数据预训练的24亿参数视觉-语言-动作模型（VLA），它在性能与模型规模之间树立了新的帕累托前沿：在LIBERO-Plus、RoboTwin Clean2Rand和RoboCasa365基准上，只有参数量约为其两倍的模型才能超越它。REKI由一个视觉-语言模型（VLM）和一个流匹配动作专家组成，在精心筛选的公开机器人数据、以自我为中心的人类数据以及视觉-语言数据的混合数据集上进行预训练。此外，我们为其赋予了一种记忆机制，使策略能够以几乎为零的成本访问其近期历史：动作专家中的几个寄存器标记（register tokens）总结VLM在每一帧的输出，并持续保留在专家的缓存中。这种记忆机制提升了仿真环境和真实机器人上的成功率，并使姿态之间的振荡减少约四倍。REKI采用简单的模型设计和训练范式，并在训练与推理效率上进行了优化。我们发布了（原文在此处截断）。
tldr: REKI是一个仅用公开数据预训练的24亿参数视觉-语言-动作模型，通过在动作专家中引入寄存器标记记忆机制来保留近期历史信息，以更小的模型规模达到了接近两倍大小模型的性能，并显著提升了仿真与真实机器人任务的成功率、大幅减少了姿态振荡。
en_tdlr: REKI is a 2.4B vision-language-action model pretrained entirely on public data that achieves a new Pareto frontier between performance and model size by using register tokens as lightweight memory, being outperformed only by models roughly twice its size while improving success rates and reducing pose oscillations fourfold.
